userPreference: Match the folder card shape as closely as possible; shared content width/default height and 8-DIP rounded child corners retained.
limitations: User performed additional grouping, detaching, deleting/undoing, resizing and source opening. This was not a single isolated detach/undo trial; final parent and relative A/B order were verified, not equality of every sibling-order number to the starting state.
Widths were checked in settled states. Intermediate manual resize observations included pending row reflow; no claim that every intermediate sampled frame matched is made.
This run did not repeat the earlier Korean IME composition matrix. Earlier native IME results are recorded separately.
